seo.title: Lawyer Warsaw – Criminal and Economic Law | Kowalski, Esq.
seo.description: Experienced lawyer in Warsaw. Protection in criminal and white-collar criminal cases. Over 15 years of practice. Confidential consultation.

hero.headline: Strategic defence in criminal and white-collar criminal cases
hero.subheadline: Over 15 years of experience in the legal protection of entrepreneurs and individuals in Warsaw. Effective representation at every stage of the proceedings – from the investigation through to the highest court.

items.title: Criminal law
items.description: Comprehensive defence at the pre-trial and trial stages. Representation of suspects and defendants in cases concerning offences against life, health, property, and sexual freedom. Protection of rights at every stage of criminal proceedings.

items.title: Economic offences
items.description: Protection of entrepreneurs, board members, and directors in cases involving fiscal offences, economic fraud, mismanagement, and money laundering. Preventive measures and representation before prosecutors and courts.

items.title: Compliance advisory
items.description: Legal audit of internal procedures, assessment of criminal risk in business transactions, preparation of legal opinions, and protection against criminal liability for board members.

items.title: Assistance at the detention stage
items.description: Immediate legal assistance in the event of detention, search, or 48-hour police custody. Presence during interrogations, filing motions for release, and securing rights at the earliest stage of proceedings.

items.title: Prosecutor's experience
items.description: Years of work in the prosecutor's office gave me insight into both sides of the criminal process. I know how the prosecution operates – and I know how to effectively defend against it.

items.title: 800+ successful cases
items.description: Extensive trial experience in cases of varying complexity – from traffic misdemeanours to multi-threaded white-collar criminal cases. Each case receives an individual defence strategy.

items.title: Ongoing corporate representation
items.description: Legal services for enterprises in the financial, construction, trade, and technology sectors. I safeguard business interests at the criminal and fiscal-criminal level.

items.title: Service in Polish and English
items.description: Cases involving foreign nationals, bilingual documentation, cooperation with foreign law firms. Representation of clients from the United Kingdom, Germany, the USA, and other countries.

pricingPreview.title: Transparent terms of cooperation
pricingPreview.description: The first consultation is free. Learn the terms before making a decision.

items.question: How much does the first consultation cost?
items.answer: The first consultation is free. You will present your situation, and I will assess the prospects of the case and propose a strategy. Only after the consultation do you decide whether to proceed with further cooperation.

items.question: How quickly can a lawyer take on a case?
items.answer: In urgent cases – detention, search, 48-hour custody – I am available 24 hours a day. In standard cases, I take the first steps within 24 hours of contact.

items.question: Do you handle cases outside Warsaw?
items.answer: Yes. Although my office is based in Warsaw, I handle cases throughout the country. In white-collar criminal cases I frequently appear before prosecutors' offices and courts in other cities.

items.question: Can I contact the lawyer outside business hours?
items.answer: In criminal cases the situation can change at any moment. Clients I work with have my direct phone number and can reach me in urgent situations. Criminal cases do not wait until morning.
